dedupe_keys.name: lpsec a fast and secure cryptographic system for optical connections

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. LPsec combines fast stream encryption, a general-purpose pseudo-random generator, Diffie-Hellman key exchange and an additional substitution cipher for optical connections. Numerical simulations examine 16QAM, 32QAM and 64QAM operation. Coverage is the proposed system as evaluated in the publication, not independently verified cryptographic security or a deployed transponder product. The source reports small added delay but does not establish public implementation files or an independently audited security margin. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
